exa.cost: one light process; Perplexity is the primary source

tortoise._comment: HTTP transport - points at the HOSTED Tortoise MCP endpoint by default, so no local daemon is required; the DB target is resolved SERVER-SIDE by the hosted API (FALKORDB_CLOUD_URI). Self-host users point the url at their own daemon instead (http://localhost:8000/mcp via docker compose - see docs/quickstart-selfhosted.md and the onboarding instructions section 3a delta). Auth is env-indirect - no key is ever committed. The old stdio command+env pattern (python3 -m tortoise.mcp_server with TORTOISE_DB_URI in env) was replaced in feat/338 (commit 6ea920f). See how-to-use-tortoise skill DB URI Reality for full env precedence on the self-hosted/stdio path (its TORTOISE_DB_URI rules describe that path, not this hosted default).

search-console._comment: Google Search Console + Bing + GA4 + AdSense via search-console-mcp (OAuth desktop flow — NO service account needed). One-time auth: run `npx search-console-mcp setup` in a terminal → browser login → token stored in macOS Keychain. Read-only (webmasters.readonly). Tools: search_analytics (up to 25k rows; query/page/country/device/date dimensions; regex filters; quick-wins), list_sites, url_inspection. Domain-property gotcha: siteUrl = sc-domain:tortoise.premiselabs.co. See issue #1862.
